tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background (warm enamel in light, deep teal-black in dark). Body text sits on it in `ink` or `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, inputs, popovers, the header. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Sunken areas: quiet chips, code, progress tracks, the Routine urgency tier. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `surface-100`, `surface-200`, `surface-300`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints, captions and placeholders on `surface-100`, `surface-200`, `surface-300`. Never below 12px.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card outlines (a 1px edge, not the only cue that a thing is a control).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of form controls and outline buttons; at least 3:1 on `surface-100` and `surface-200`.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Brand teal: primary buttons, links, active states, the logo pin. Also text on `surface-100`/`surface-200` (links).

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of a primary button.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `brand` or `brand-hover` fill.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Soft brand fill: secondary buttons, selected chips, the Scheduled urgency tier, ratings tiles.

tokens.name: on-brand-tint
tokens.usage: Text on `brand-tint`.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: solid 3px, 2px offset; at least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Emergency fill, error text and invalid borders on `surface-100`/`surface-200`/`danger-soft`.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `danger` fill (the Emergency notice, destructive buttons).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the emergency card and inline error blocks. Text: `danger` or `ink`.

tokens.name: danger-line
tokens.usage: Border of danger blocks; 3:1 on `danger-soft`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `warning-soft`: the Soon urgency tier, low-confidence price lists.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of caution blocks. Text: `warning` or `ink`.

tokens.name: warning-line
tokens.usage: Border of caution blocks; 3:1 on `warning-soft`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `success-soft` and `surface-200`: Verified, accepted, saved.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success badges and notes. Text: `success` or `ink`.

tokens.name: success-line
tokens.usage: Border of success blocks; 3:1 on `success-soft`.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `info-soft`: neutral notices, BPJS notes, source citations.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of info blocks. Text: `info` or `ink`.

tokens.name: info-line
tokens.usage: Border of info blocks; 3:1 on `info-soft`.

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: Filled rating stars; 3:1 on `surface-200`. Always paired with a number, never alone.

families.sans: "Figtree", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Roboto, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Landing headline only, one per page.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Lead paragraph under a title; Guidance reasons.
styles.sample: Ceritakan keluhan gigi Anda dengan kata-kata sendiri.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text and form input text (16px keeps iOS from zooming).
styles.sample: Gigi geraham kiri bawah nyut-nyutan sejak tiga hari.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body copy; never bold a whole paragraph.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, button text on small buttons, tab labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Smallest allowed text: badges, units, legal notes.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Section eyebrows; set in uppercase in the component, not in the copy.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Rupiah amounts and ranges; turn on tabular figures.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: Rating numbers next to stars, e.g. 4,6/5.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between chips, buttons in a row (minimum gap between touch targets).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input padding, gap inside a list item.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on mobile, gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a card; page gutter from 640px.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Top padding of a page on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Large section breaks; default button height.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero spacing on desktop.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum width and height of anything tappable.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, inline marks, tiny chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, notices.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets, large hero containers, the app icon.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Filter chips, language toggle, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Buttons at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Popovers, sticky action bars, a card being dragged.
